targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(event_date) AS time, sum(row_count) AS jobs
FROM smf.stats_jobs_daily
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date), ' ', if(time = '', '00:00:00', time)))) AS time,
  count() AS ends
FROM smf.smf_30_5
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT job_name, sum(row_count) AS ends
FROM smf.stats_jobs_daily
WHERE job_name != ''
GROUP BY job_name
ORDER BY ends DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.title: Top programs / steps (non-empty only)
panels.description: Many 30-5 rows have blank step/program in this dump — only non-empty values are listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  nullIf(program_name, '') AS program_name,
  nullIf(step_name, '') AS step_name,
  count() AS rows
FROM smf.smf_30_5
WHERE program_name != '' OR step_name != ''
GROUP BY program_name, step_name
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 40

SELECT
  event_date,
  smf_system_id,
  job_name,
  nullIf(step_name, '') AS step_name,
  nullIf(program_name, '') AS program_name,
  count() AS rows
FROM smf.smf_30_5
GROUP BY event_date, smf_system_id, job_name, step_name, program_name
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 100
